containers.name: ugv-sync
command: unset ROS_HOSTNAME; source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.bash; source /slicer/catkin_ws/devel_navigation/setup.bash; until rosservice list 2>/dev/null | grep -qx /master_discovery/list_masters; do sleep 2; done; exec roslaunch /slicer/config/fkie_ugv_sync.launch

containers.name: ugv-state-relay
command: unset ROS_HOSTNAME; source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.bash; export ROS_NAMESPACE=/ugv/communication; exec python3 -B /slicer/communication/relay.py --config /slicer/communication/config/relay.yaml

containers.name: ugv-discovery
command:
unset ROS_HOSTNAME
source /opt/ros/noetic/setup.bash
until rosparam get /rosdistro >/dev/null 2>&1; do
sleep 2
done
exec rosrun fkie_master_discovery master_discovery \
"_robot_hosts:=$ROBOT_HOSTS"

excluded: firmware flash images and unrelated firmware trees
